pinning.reason: The host prepares and fetches NOTHING for this asset set (assets and groups are empty by design): the vendor package downloads roughly 367 MB of weights into its own version-keyed cache on first load, at the MODEL package's initiative. This revision is the lock's own model.revision value restated so a preparation plan has an identity; it is prose on purpose, because the lock does not pin an artifact version it does not fetch. A zero-asset preparation is the truthful plan here — it records that nothing was downloaded rather than claiming bytes that were never fetched.

voz-weights.note: Voz downloads roughly 367 MB of weights into its own cache on first load, at the MODEL package's initiative rather than the host's. The empty asset array asserts the host prepares and fetches nothing itself; preparation of downloaded executables still requires the separate executable-preparation approval before first use.
